title: 18 more AL/BC patterns: data-modeling, testing, style, security, error-handling, ui, upgrade, web-services, appsource
summary: BCQuality adds 18 new knowledge articles covering data modeling, testing, style, security, error handling, UI, upgrade, web services, and AppSource patterns with code examples and best practices.
key_points: 18 articles across data modeling (WorkDate, Media for pictures, table-type conventions), testing (BCPT, tagging, test structure) and style
Security, error handling, UI, upgrade, web services and AppSource guidance on permission sets, rollback-safe logging, page types, upgrade tag nesting, API write access and version bumps
Sibling good and bad AL samples are included where a code contrast helps
Four drafted articles were dropped as duplicates or overlaps of existing files
Review skills updated to reference the new articles
quote: 18 more knowledge articles generalized from patterns observed across real AppSource/PTE Business Central development
